args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is verified. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production; v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and was also unhealthy. Follow-up: confirm error rate recovery on v2.3.0, investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release, and check whether anything else depends on v2.3.1.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is the unhealthy production release that caused the failures. v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and was also unhealthy.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the v2.3.1 failures (error rate 0.18), the rollback to v2.3.0, and the follow-up work. It paged the on-call engineer.

I did not check the post-rollback error rate, so confirm that checkout-api is recovering on v2.3.0.
